RIBBON_PANE_TIP: Show or hide the AI Assistant task pane of this window.
SETTINGS_SAVE_PROGRESS: Save a record of each request
SETTINGS_EXTERNAL_CONTROL_HINT: Other programs running as the same user can send requests to this add-in (for testing)
ABOUT_HINT: The version and the commit it was built from (+ means a build with uncommitted changes)
RETRY_BAR: Stopped by an error on the server.
INPUT_PLACEHOLDER: Describe the slides you want (drop or paste documents and pictures to attach them)
ATTACH_HINT: Attach a document or picture (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, text, image)
NEW_CHAT_HINT: Start over without the earlier requests
SELECTION_HINT: Sent to the AI with your request
READY: Ready. Describe the slides you want and send.
NO_ENDPOINT_HELP: No endpoint is set. Enter the endpoint's URL above and press Fetch; if it needs a key, enter it with Set next to API key.
NO_ENDPOINT_OR_MODEL: No endpoint or model is set. Enter the endpoint above, press Fetch and choose a model. Stored in: {0}
API_KEY_SAVED: Saved the API key in Windows Credential Manager
API_KEY_SAVE_FAILED: Could not save the API key in Windows Credential Manager
MODELS_FAILED: Could not fetch the model list: {0} - {1}
MODELS_FAILED_KEPT: Could not fetch the model list: {0} - {1}. The endpoint stays {2}
MODEL_NOT_LISTED: Note: the saved model {0} is not in this endpoint's list
EXTERNAL_CONTROL_ON: Other programs may now control this add-in
EXTERNAL_CONTROL_OFF: Other programs may no longer control this add-in
SAVE_PROGRESS_ON: Saving a record of each request in {0}
SAVE_PROGRESS_OFF: Stopped saving records of the requests
STARTER_SLIDE_REMOVED: Removed the empty title slide the presentation started with
SCRIPTS_ELIDED: The conversation got long, so {0} old script(s) were left out
DOC_READS_ELIDED: The conversation got long, so the text of {0} document read(s) already done was left out
STATUS_SERVER_ERROR: Turn {0}: server error. Waiting for Retry
STATUS_BUSY_ELSEWHERE: A request is running in another window
TURN_SIZE: Turn {0}: input {1} / output {2} = reasoning {3} + text {4} / {5} s
AI_SERVER_ERROR: Stopped by an error on the server ({0}). The work so far stays as it is. Press Retry to send the same request again, or Stop to end it.
AI_TURN_LIMIT: Reached the limit of {0} turns; ending.
AI_REPLY_CUT: The model's reply reached the output limit ({0} tokens) and was cut off, so the request ends here.
AI_DECK_CLOSED: The presentation this request was working on was closed, so the request ends here.
STREAM_INCOMPLETE: the reply ended before it was complete
IMAGE_NOT_SENT: Could not pass the picture {0} {1} to the model; the next request tries again
DOC_DISCARDED: {0} was not attached: the conversation changed while it was being read
DOC_STILL_CONVERTING: Wait until the documents have been read, then send
DOC_FAILED_ENCRYPTED: It is protected with a password
DOC_FAILED_NEEDS_OCR: Some pages are only scanned images, so their text cannot be read
DOC_FAILED_MALFORMED: The file seems to be damaged
DOC_FAILED_RESOURCE_LIMIT: It is too large or too complex to read
DOC_FAILED_MISSING_PART: A part the file needs is missing
DOC_FAILED_TOO_LARGE: Files over 50 MB cannot be attached
DOC_FAILED: An error occurred while reading it
DOC_FAILED_DETAIL: An error occurred while reading it: {0}
LOAD_ERROR: The task pane could not be shown. It needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime.
API_KEY_DIALOG_NOTE: Enter the endpoint's API key. It is stored in Windows Credential Manager and never shown.
